reference.title: Typical structure
reference.shortdesc: A ReadMe project usually has folders like docs/, reference/, recipes/, custom_pages/, etc. A sample structure

section.p: A ReadMe project usually has folders like docs/, reference/, recipes/, custom_pages/, etc. A sample structure (from official docs) is provided below.
section.codeblock: ruby project/ ├── custom_blocks/ # (optional) reusable content ├── custom_pages/ # (optional) standalone pages ├── docs/ # guides and how-to docs │ ├── Getting Started/ # category folder │ │ ├── introduction.md │ │ └── _order.yaml │ └── _order.yaml ├── recipes/ # code “recipes” or examples ├── reference/ # API reference (often OpenAPI) └── _order.yaml # (optional) defines sidebar order
